College Basketball: UT Martin and Utah Valley Win at Paradise Jam

At the Paradise Jam tournament, UT Martin secured a 90-81 victory over Temple, with Davi Remagen scoring 31 points. In another game, Utah Valley narrowly defeated UT Martin 78-76 in overtime, led by Dominick Nelson's 28 points.
